title: luzula campestris var. genuina
intro: Luzula campestris var. genuina, commonly known as Field Woodrush, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Field Woodrush include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Luzula campestris var. genuina include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
